notes.title: Now speaking 11 languages!
notes.content:
Game is now enjoyable in 3 new languages: Português, Italiano and Русский making it a total 10 available 
languages:
[list]
[*]English
[*]Español	
[*]Deutsch	
[*]Français	
[*]Português	
[*]Italiano	
[*]Česky
[*]Slovensky	
[*]Srpski
[*]Русский	
[*]Беларуская
[/list]

[b]Update:[/b] added Srpski language

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/dd2d11d74b8df8555183441e2c1ccf4ac41ab8dd.png[/img]

Big thanks to all the translators and hopefully now almost everybody can enjoy the game :). If however you're still missing your language and you're willing to help with translation (~650 words), please contact me via steam or FB page https://www.facebook.com/bonvoyagepuzzle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/ace3a133cb7aca699115467c972f25b83e69a97a.png[/img]

Las but not least, maybe you've missed great showcase sale of games created in former Czechoslovakia but here is a list so you can pick some nice game from my talented colleagues and friends:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/SCSsoftware/sale/CZSKGamesWeek]CZ/SK Games[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/SCSsoftware/sale/CZSKGamesWeek][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/266286a84ce9f1d2e98fc607dbec35e83a4dfabf.png[/img][/url]

Happy holidays, my friends!
Boris

notes.title: Xmas level pack!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/c9cc36686dc35c73ac2352e9e6fcb53cbb7c706a.png[/img]

Friends, Christmas time has come and as thank you I'm adding new free level pack so you can return to some puzzle solving. It can be found at the end of [b]Levels[/b] tab. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/d0e301e2bcb758a9d89cad7343ee80a16724e898.jpg[/img]

Furthermore there are [b]two additional changes[/b]:
[list]
[*]per request [b]sound button[/b] now has 3 states (all on, sound on but music off and all off), so you can play game with your own music but still hear the game ambient ;)
[*]game now support Cyrillic alphabet and [b]Belarus localization[/b] has been added (thanks Lex.by!), if anybody wants to provide other languages, please contact me and your name will be a part of the game! 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/fe6285f618f67bb24f0f1a4dd8ba77bafee59500.jpg[/img]

[b]Have a wonderful Christmas!
Boris[/b]

notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.content:
Tired of ever sunny weather in misty world? Try the new night mode to turn the levels into Halloween mysterious lands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/358bbc8e7fe6c70eb8e78c964c08bf03deca6510.png[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xFalwF6QJcg

[i]Accessible with latest update via settings menu, checkbox [b]Night Mode[/b][/i], turn it on/off whenever you like, not affecting gameplay nor achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35074301/5301f36160bf3726f046be65cd822df66eeb091e.png[/img]

Enjoy!

Yours,
Boris

notes.title: Patch 1.03 (zoom and shift)
notes.content:
Dear players,

today I've shipped one [b]small update[/b] of how zooming and shifting works: 

[list]
[*]You can now shift diagonally not only along axes
[*]Now the speed depends on how close camera is to the level (closer -> slower) making it easier to navigate
[*]Additionally bug with shifting working incorrectly with camera rotated heavily from initial position was fixed
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/27fe2135f63f03eda802e74a24539207e53b92e3.png[/img]

Now I plan to prepare a pack of fresh new levels (and free as promised), so stay tuned!

Yours,
Boris

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hi guys!

A few issues have been identified by the helpful community (or me) and addressed lately. Please update the game to the latest version (check there are no scheduled updates in Downloads or restart Steam):

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: rarely knights got stuck during navigation, mainly in randomized levels, resulting in level needed to be restarted
[*] [b]FIX[/b]: sometimes knight animation was warping back a bit, non game breaking
[*] [b]TWEAK[/b]: level 60 removed unintentional tree covering road (was solvable anyway)
[*] [b]TWEAK[/b]: level 70 was unintentionally made much harder, tweaked now, original version can be found in Levels/Level Stack for those who like the challenge :)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/d3eba2eeab9afa7a75ad875bf7b5d7ff11815152.png[/img]
Swapping these two tiles makes a lot of difference, believe me, harder version is solvable but requires an alternate route search :)

In case you run into any problems with the game, don't hesitate to contact me, I'll do my best to make it better!

Have fun!

Yours,
Boris

notes.title: Welcome to BonVoyage!
notes.content:
The day has come! [b]We are live![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/6e9f6f5f6b3eccc0841dcbc3908a70e75a62f13a.png[/img]

Dear steam user, I sincerely hope you'll have a good time playing this game!

https://youtu.be/WSjjEBAeYzs

Don't forget that if you are stuck, there are always 5 unfinished levels unlocked, so try a different one and return to the problematic one later. If it doesn't help, please write a message and I'll try to point you in the right direction :).

Additionally:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/3bbefcfd6bc3b9b9c5f66b8c7caca212906b2c80.png[/img]

 [list]
    [*]Each level summarizes used mechanics in [b]Settings[/b] menu
    [*]All tutorials can be found at one place under [b]Levels[/b] tab
[/list]

A bunch of additional levels that didn't make it into the campaign can be played there, all unlocked ;). Furthermore I'll add some [b]free level packs[/b] later on and those will be here as well!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/c78d448525743c2dd0a782e566436eb95cac70a8.png[/img]

If the game feels too easy try timer mode or uncheck Simplify in settings to hide path helpers and show your skills, unlock badges and additional achievements :).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/576512fbb795963b991d070d224e70e602bf6d2c.png[/img]

Last but not least, try random level generator ([b]Randomizer[/b]) for a change of pace. Each reload will create a new random level, you can choose from a few settings at the beginning to affect resulting shuffle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/cb68eee63bf2fbea077406dbf3ee7d00f63ead9a.png[/img]

[i]Please, if you like the experience consider writing a review, even a super short one, reaching 10 reviews unlocks the overall percentage for the game that helps very much with the visibility to others[/i]

Have a nice puzzle time!

Yours truly,
Boris

notes.title: Almost there!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/2125f7abb0415c50611159ea80e09c699e84067e.png[/img]

The [b]build was officially approved[/b] and release date is getting close!

Nevertheless I'm still hard at work and have overhauled lighting a bit again so now it hopefully looks really good and cartoony :). More levels were added as well. And of course as with my previous award winning game [b]Car Puzzler[/b] I'll add free level pack over time as updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/774191/Car_Puzzler/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/7567763fd2f112538b096ebc09d68c266a0fbd95.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/d12f22340cbf4b450b86e0147b36140933ef839b.png[/img]

So to sum it up:
[list]
    [*]Visual polish? Check!
    [*]More levels? Check!
    [*]Excitement? Check! Check!
[/list]

Mark the date [b]20th of June[/b] as Steam release date, prepare to be puzzled ;)!

[b]Last but not least I have two questions for you:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Would you prefer localization support for game with this minimum of text? It can be added if requested
[*]I can enable the level editor and custom level sharing the way it was done in Car Puzzler, would you be interested? Please let me know in comments, your levels can be a part of future updates with your name credited!
[/olist]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35074301/6e9f6f5f6b3eccc0841dcbc3908a70e75a62f13a.png[/img]
